name: mla-file-management-system
description: MLA File Management System - constituency-level request, file and document management

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace shared && npm-run-all --parallel dev:shared dev:server dev:client
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace server && npm run lint --workspace client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace client
scripts.seed: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run seed --workspace server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
